## Purpose
Renders the "Library" dashboard page: a searchable, filterable catalog of every agent, skill, and hook available in the system, with detail modals for skills and hooks and a drawer for agent capabilities.

## Shape
- `LibraryPage` — the main export; owns tab (`agents`/`skills`/`hooks`), category/search, and selected-item state, and renders one of three filtered grids (agent cards, skill cards, hook cards) plus their modals.
- `SkillDetailModal` — parses a skill's markdown content into heading/body sections for display, with copy-to-clipboard.
- `HookDetailModal` — shows a hook's event type, trigger, usage steps, and compatible agents, with copy-to-clipboard.
- `ALL_AGENTS_COMBINED` / `CATEGORIES` / `PIPELINE_LABEL` — static catalog data merging `LIBRARY_AGENTS` and `CUSTOM_AGENTS`, plus category/pipeline-type label maps used for filtering and chip rendering.
- Selecting an agent card opens `AgentCapabilitiesModal` as a drawer; per-agent config selections are persisted across drawer open/close cycles via a `useRef` map keyed by agent id.

## Why this shape
No explicit rationale is stated in the code for the three-tab/grid layout; it is a straightforward filtered-catalog pattern (category chips + search + card grid) repeated three times for agents/skills/hooks, with modal/drawer detail views kept as local components since they are only used here.
